title: backlog.json defaults are the kb's own values, so a host project must override review_checks, research_checks, the land steps, docs_map and kb_root (second-project run)
goal: A project with no backlog.json, or one naming none of these keys, gets defaults that name no kb file: review_checks, research_checks, land_stale, land_eval, land_lint, docs_map and kb_root default to empty, and the kb's backlog.json names its own values, so its behaviour is unchanged

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'config'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(1 if 'kb_root = "_self"  (default)' in o else 0)

notes: Run setup: backlog.py --root <empty project> config printed review_checks = [... _tools/backlog.py check ... _tools/tests.py], land_eval = ["_tools/rag.py", "eval"], docs_map = "kb/_self/map.csv", kb_root = "_self", all (default); the host's backlog.json had to set each to [] or "".
